maximum_depth_rule: The single reviewed row remains a raw maximum-depth record because it describes the annual inspection and analysis process, rather than one of the 89 social target values, an annual actual, or a policy achievement result.
version_boundary: The current 2025-2028 plan and its 89 social targets remain separate from the 2022-2024 former plan, its 76 social targets, and its final evaluation. Former-plan actuals are not reassigned to current-plan targets.
non_goals: Do not treat the annual review-process description as one of the 89 KPI values.
Do not interpret PDF character-extraction noise as a numeric measurement.
Do not inherit former-plan actuals or final evaluation into the current plan.
Do not replace units or split the raw sentence into inferred fields.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
